data.title: shibuya/BRANDING.md: add street-canyon perspective + 3 depth layers vanishing to center

data.body: User request on FA-13's deliverable: the direction should have two-point perspective and depth — perhaps 3 layers — vanishing towards the center. Interpretation: the street reads as a canyon; left and right walls of vertical signage converge on a central vanishing point, with three depth layers (near/mid/far) carrying scale, brightness and blur falloff. Amend shibuya/BRANDING.md (edit, don't rewrite): add a perspective/depth system section with copy-pasteable CSS (shared perspective on a parent, perspective-origin center, rotateY walls, layer tokens), and update layout/composition + page application to compose through it. Reconcile terminology honestly (a central vanishing point is the street-canyon read of the request).
Amended brief per plan; renumbered §7-10; cross-refs verified; committed da8ecb1

Reviewed da8ecb1 (shibuya/BRANDING.md canyon amendment) cold against the plan. VERDICT: PASS — no rework, no inline fixes needed. Verified: (1) commit touches only shibuya/BRANDING.md; contrast section byte-identical before/after, hex count unchanged (35/35), only hex-adjacent diff line is the karaoke row's §7->§8 ref. (2) Headings sequential 1-10; all §-refs resolve in context — §8 refs land on hue-cycle/ticker/hover-pair/motion-bans, §10 refs on isolation and no-fixed bullets, §7.3 refs on the gotcha list; the five planned ref fixes (pre-edit lines 62/312/435/599/623) all applied. (3) CSS parses (braces/parens balanced, 25 decls), contract-legal: no ids, no :is() commas, no position:fixed, no preserve-3d, no keyframes. Geometry verified numerically: hinged rotateY(+-58deg) walls under one 900px perspective with origin 50%/50% — projection math confirms far edges converge toward centre (1200px vp: far edge pulled from x=394 to x=479 toward 600); transform-origin on outer edges pins near ends correctly; .canyon-end 2D-translate centred on the origin. overflow:clip is conservative but sound (blur bleed / transformed-descendant scrollable overflow). (4) Flattening list matches the spec grouping-property set (overflow!=visible, filter, opacity<1, clip-path, mask, mix-blend-mode, isolation:isolate, contain:paint); one-level-3D-tree + isolation-on-root coexistence claim is correct (grouping props bite preserve-3d propagation, not the perspective property); filter-on-.canyon corollary correct; brightness-dims-text-shadow claim correct; 3D-text rasterisation claim correct. (5) One-point vs two-point reconciled explicitly and in-voice (7.1). (6) Depth contrast rule unambiguous: readable = near/flat/unfiltered passes §2 glow-off; wall/filtered = aria-hidden scenery; restated in §10 test. (7) Voice/format parity holds (tabs, bold-lead bullets, British spellings, wry declaratives). All 9 acceptance criteria met.
